plugins.network: Yes: api.anthropic.com (or your configured provider) for the LLM diff review at the end of each turn and the agentic review on git commit, using your Claude Code credentials. pip/PyPI on first run.
plugins.note: First-party Anthropic, but the heaviest plugin here. It spends model usage on every turn that changes code (Opus by default; set the documented model env vars to use a cheaper one). plugins.name: impeccable
scripts: scripts/live-browser.js (local live-edit server, talks to localhost with a token)
plugins.network: Yes: on first hook run it downloads a prebuilt engine binary from github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/releases, checks its SHA-256 against engine-checksums.txt (refuses on mismatch or when no hash tool exists), caches it and executes it on every edit. IMPECCABLE_BIN can point at a binary you built yourself.
plugins.note: Medium. It's the only adopted plugin that downloads and runs a binary. It's checksum-pinned to the commit we pin, so the binary changes only when we bump the SHA. Re-check engine-checksums.txt in the diff on every update.
